draft_saved: Draft kept in the JGates data folder; the project file did not change.
restored: Text restored from the draft of {when}. The project file stays as it was.
restored_stale: The file changed on disk after this draft. Saving shows the difference instead of overwriting.
visual_suspended: The text has a syntax error: form editing is suspended until it is fixed. The typed text is preserved.
pending_lead: The run uses the files saved on disk. For each document, choose to save the change (the plan is rebuilt with the new hash) or to use the saved version (the change stays only as a draft).
pending_save: Save and use the new version
pending_save_invalid: Save even with a syntax error
pending_stale: The file changed on disk after the draft: saving will ask for reconciliation.
pending_invalid: The draft has a syntax error: {message}
pending_conflict: The file changed on disk and the draft was not saved. Open the file in the tool area to reconcile.
pending_other: Drafts of documents the plan does not use are not run and stay as they are.
pending_unresolved: There are changes without a choice.
